title: List Comprehension with Conditional
description: Creates a new list by filtering and transforming another list.
code:
numbers = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
even_squares = [x**2 for x in numbers if x % 2 == 0]
# Output: [4, 16, 36]
explanation_md: List comprehensions provide a concise way to create lists based on existing lists.

title: Context Manager (with statement)
description: Ensures resources are properly closed after use.
code:
with open("example.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write("Hello, World!")
# File is automatically closed here
explanation_md: The `with` statement simplifies exception handling by encapsulating common preparation and cleanup tasks.

title: Decorator Function
description: Modifies the behavior of a function or class.
explanation_md: Decorators allow you to wrap another function in order to extend the behavior of the wrapped function, without permanently modifying it.

title: Dictionary Merging
description: Merges two dictionaries using the | operator (Python 3.9+).
explanation_md: The merge operator `|` provides a clean way to combine dictionaries, with the second dictionary's values taking precedence.

title: Generator Expression
description: Creates an iterator without storing the entire list in memory.
code:
large_range = (x**2 for x in range(1000000))
print(next(large_range))
print(next(large_range))
explanation_md: Generators yield items one at a time, making them highly memory-efficient for large datasets.
